svg.title: Foundation revision: cooler palette, Barlow type, selected twelve-degree geometry and Phosphor icons
svg.text: I CAN FIX HIM / SELECTED 07 / FOUNDATION 02
Cooler color. One slant. Shared parts.
ExtraBold Italic / adjusted to selected 12° lean
Regular for dialogue. Semibold for replies.
It’s not personal. Everything I own is riding
on this flip. If it fails, I lose it all.
SLANTED EDGES + PLACEMENT GRID = 12° / HORIZONTAL BASELINES
Long replies stay upright and wrap.
No construction stripes. No ray flourish. No extra yellow accent.
These are editable vector masters using the actual font files and library SVGs, not generated lettering.
